authorship: Original AI-assisted fictional engineering fixtures, authored for issue #11. No patient records, copied clinical publications, real interventions or third-party datasets. Designer reference authored by the same assistant; not independent ground truth.

cases.label: Fictional case A - specimen preparation inquiry
Fictional case B - screening clarification and routine-request control

questions: Using only sources received by this cutoff, which preparation or verification questions warrant accountable human review, and why?
Which source statements are reported, unverified, missing, conflicting, corrected or about planned rather than completed actions?
For every candidate option or preparation concern, cite exact sources and separate evidence support, access, readiness and authority. Abstain where unsupported.
What changed since the prior available packet? Preserve historical sources and identify claims requiring renewed review without treating drafts as accepted conclusions.
Which routine items do not justify a time-sensitive alert? Do not invent deadlines, treatment advice, eligibility, availability or completed actions.
